question: Who among the following was given the title of Mallika-e-Ghazal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Begum Akhtar**__.

__
 
• **Akhtari Bai Faizabadi**, also known as **Begum Akhtar**, was an Indian singer and actress who was given the title of "**Mallika-e-Ghazal**" (Queen of Ghazals).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The legendary **Begum Akhtar** was a doyen of **Hindustani classical music**, particularly in the ghazal genre.
 
• Her musical tradition was so unique that she came to be associated with her own distinct style of **singing.** She was rightly called the ‘**Mallika-e-Ghazal**’.
 
• She came to be associated with Hindustani classical music, excelling in **ghazal, Dadra, and thumri**.
 
• As a child,** Begum Akhtar or Akhtari Bai Faizabadi**, began her classical music training rather early as she reportedly showed sparks even as a kid, captivated by the music of Chandra Bai, a touring theatre artist of the day. 
 
• She received the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for vocal music and was awarded **Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan** (posthumously) by Govt. of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iqbal Bano** was a ghazal singer from Pakistan. She was known for her semi-classical Urdu ghazal songs and classical thumris but also sang easy-listening numbers in 1950s films.
 
• **Nayyara Noor** is a Pakistani playback singer who is considered one of the Indian subcontinent's popular film songs playback singers and a stage performer. She performs in live ghazal singing concerts on Pakistan television shows or in concert halls in the country.
 
• **Farida Khanum** is a Pakistani classical singer from the city of Kolkata West Bengal. She is also known for her honorific title Malika-e-Ghazal in both Pakistan and India.
